environment: IWER desktop emulator, Quest 3 profile, IWSDK 1.1.0, headless Chromium

rows.title: Enter XR
rows.preconditions: Page loaded; no XR session
rows.inputs: xr exit; page reload; xr enter
rows.expected: Session active; game state Title; envelope present
rows.actual: session active (visible), game Title, envelope visible=true

rows.title: Exit and re-enter
rows.preconditions: Immersive; chapter at cp-stairhead (set in-page; the save is written by the game)
rows.inputs: xr exit; xr enter; fingertip on the continue seal
rows.expected: Title offers continue; state equals the checkpoint snapshot
rows.actual: while out of VR: game Title; after re-entry: Title, continue seal visible; fingertip on continue resumed at cp-stairhead (v-stair-head); committed seams, vantage, postmarks and Surveyor equal the cp-stairhead snapshot; rig/station alignment error 0 m

rows.title: Hands available
rows.preconditions: Immersive; hand input mode
rows.inputs: set-input-mode hand; then disconnect both hands and wait
rows.expected: Two hand input sources; no hands card. With hands disconnected: hands card appears
rows.actual: with hands: both sources present, card hidden; hands disconnected 6.5 s: sources false/false, card visible; reconnected: card cleared

rows.title: One-hand grab
rows.preconditions: Immersive; chapter at v-foyer-door (precondition set in-page)
rows.inputs: Right hand pinches the seam-hall travel grip, releases; left hand does the same
rows.expected: Grip held by the pinching hand (domain phase held, holder hand correct). SDK Grabbed tag: not used by design (plan P3)
rows.actual: right hand held it (phase held, holder right); left hand held it (phase held, holder left); both released to rest

rows.title: Two-hand grab
rows.preconditions: Immersive; chapter at v-stair-head, seam-hall at 1 (checkpoint cp-stairhead)
rows.inputs: Right pinches travel grip alone; then left holds anchor, right takes travel; then roles swapped
rows.expected: First: refused Latched. Then held. Works with roles swapped
rows.actual: travel alone refused (Latched); anchor left + travel right: held; anchor right + travel left: held

rows.title: Seam movement
rows.preconditions: Immersive; at v-foyer-door (seam-hall)
rows.inputs: Hold travel grip; move the hand along the rail in five steps, then beyond its end
rows.expected: param follows in step and clamps at 1; module follows within the speed cap; grip stays on the rail
rows.actual: param followed 0.2->0.202, 0.4->0.402, 0.6->0.602, 0.8->0.802, 1->1; beyond the end clamped at 1; grip on the rail (0.180, 0.950, -0.420); peak drawn speed 0.54/s <= cap 0.83/s (1805 frames sampled)

rows.title: Snap acceptance
rows.preconditions: Immersive; at v-foyer-door
rows.inputs: Hold travel grip; move to within the snap window of detent 1; release
rows.expected: Settles to the detent within 0.8 s; edge appears; lamp for the next vantage lit
rows.actual: preview named foyer.north|stair.foot (strength 1.00); snapped to detent 1; settle 84 ms (limit 800); edge foyer.north|stair.foot open; v-stair-head lamp lit (r=1.34)

rows.title: Snap rejection
rows.preconditions: Immersive; (a) at v-foyer-door, (b) at v-stair-head with seam-hall at 1
rows.inputs: (a) mid-rail release of seam-hall. (b) brace, drag seam-landing to its half-way detent, release
rows.expected: (a) returns; edges unchanged. (b) rests at the half-way detent; no edge
rows.actual: (a) released mid-rail: return, committed 0, edges unchanged; (b) landing rests at detent 1 (half-way), no landing.west|stair.head edge, v-landing-east not reachable

rows.title: Blocked path
rows.preconditions: Immersive; at v-ceast-end (cp-east), lift at corridor level
rows.inputs: Hold the arm lever and pull it to the end
rows.expected: param stops at the block; SeamBlocked raised; release returns it
rows.actual: pulled to the end: param stopped at 0.573 (by lift); SeamBlocked raised; release returned it to detent 0

rows.title: Hop
rows.preconditions: Immersive; chapter at v-foyer-start (cp-arrival)
rows.inputs: Right hand ray at the lit lamp, pinch-select; then at v-foyer-door aim at the unlit stair-head lamp, pinch-select
rows.expected: Fade; rig at the new vantage anchor; domain vantage updated. Unlit lamp: nothing
rows.actual: lit lamp (ray length 9.94 m): faded to 1, back to 0; rig 0 m from the vantage anchor; vantage v-foyer-door. Unlit stair-head lamp: no hop, no fade

rows.title: Hand loss during a move
rows.preconditions: Immersive; at v-foyer-door; right hand holding the seam-hall grip
rows.inputs: Disconnect the holding hand 0.1 s and reconnect; then 1 s (mid-rail); then 1 s with the grip inside the snap window
rows.expected: Short loss: hold continues. Long loss: released; returns unless within a snap window
rows.actual: 0.1 s loss -> held at 0.502 (IWER resets the pinch on reconnect, so the test restores it, as a user's still-closed fingers would be); 1 s loss mid-rail -> return, committed 0, rest; 1 s loss inside the snap window -> snap, committed 1; never committed outside a snap window

rows.title: Pause and resume
rows.preconditions: Immersive; cp-corridor, Surveyor approaching; right hand holding the seam-bridge grip
rows.inputs: updateVisibilityState hidden; wait 3 s; visible
rows.expected: Grip released; tick count unchanged while hidden; Surveyor in the same place
rows.actual: hidden: game Pause, grip released (settling, committed 0); over 3 s hidden ticks 393->393, Surveyor walk 76->76 in c-east; visible again: ticks resumed (393->423), game ThreatEncounter

rows.title: Restart
rows.preconditions: Immersive; chapter at cp-landing with intensity reduced and snap turn 30
rows.inputs: Right index fingertip held on the restart seal for 2.4 s
rows.expected: State equals initial; settings kept
rows.actual: held 2.4 s: back to cp-arrival at v-foyer-start, game Exploration; seams, postmarks, objectives, letter, tally all equal a fresh chapter; settings kept (reduced, snap 30)

rows.title: Surveyor follows the graph
rows.preconditions: Immersive; cp-corridor; right hand holding the seam-bridge lever (real-time, no ECS stepping)
rows.inputs: A: swing the bridge while it is in the East Corridor, swing back when it is in the office. B: swing while it is on the bridge
rows.expected: A: den, c-east, bridge, dead-letter; counts 3, 2, 2, 1; no-route signal; ends Searching in dead-letter. B: Blocked for the block time, then replans. Drawn body always in the reported room
rows.actual: A: rooms c-east > bridge > dead-letter; counts 3,2,2,1; no-route signal; ends Searching in dead-letter; 401 body samples, 0 outside the reported room | B: swung while it was on the bridge: Blocked for 4.0 s (limit 4 s), then Replanning, then reached dead-letter; 331 body samples, 0 outside

rows.title: Full chapter
rows.preconditions: Immersive; chapter at the title with default settings
rows.inputs: The reference solution of first-chapter.md section 10 as one hands-only script: title seal, ray-pinch hops, grips and braces on all six seams, the encounter, the letter into pigeonhole 0
rows.expected: Each checkpoint in order; ChapterComplete reached; no errors in the console
rows.actual: Completed in 521.3 s wall clock with hands only (26 timeline marks, artifacts/rt15-timeline.json). Checkpoints ENTRANCE > STAIR > LANDING > WEST > EAST > LAST POST; ChapterComplete; 5 objectives; caught 1 time(s); no console errors. Observed interaction failures (retried): hop to v-stair-head: attempt 1 had no effect (__rz.session.vantage === 'v-stair-head' && __rz.fade < 0.05); hop to v-stair-head: needed 2 attempts; hop to v-landing-east: attempt 1 had no effect (__rz.session.vantage === 'v-landing-east' && __rz.fade < 0.05); hop to v-landing-east: needed 2 attempts; take the bridge lever again: attempt 1 had no effect (__rz.session.seams['seam-bridge'].phase === 'held'); take the bridge lever again: needed 2 attempts; fast hop from v-lift: press had no effect
rows.note: Three defects were found by this test and fixed: taking the letter switched the "hands" setting (settings seals answered to any fingertip; now only while the letter is offered and no hand pinches, with a unit test), and two harness faults (the console-error check read old injected errors; the finale ignored a catch). Emulator quirk, not a game fault (the game received no press at all): the first ray press by a hand that has just run a scripted seam sequence is lost, the identical second press works (hop-trial and diagnostics in artifacts/). The finale uses the left hand with pre-computed aims because the Surveyor reaches the player about 9 s after the dock and each emulator command costs about 1.4 s.

rows.title: Envelope seals
rows.preconditions: Immersive; chapter just begun, letter in view
rows.inputs: Right index fingertip on each settings seal (turn, intensity, hands); then page reload
rows.expected: Settings change in the domain and persist across reload
rows.actual: turn 0->30, intensity standard->reduced, hands two->one; stored in localStorage ({"snapTurn":30,"intensity":"reduced","hands":"one","volume":1}); after reload the game read the same settings
rows.note: Spec step "turn the letter over" is not applicable: the settings seals sit on the letter face in this build

rows.title: Controllers
rows.preconditions: Immersive; at v-foyer-door; input mode switched to controllers
rows.inputs: Squeeze to grab the seam-hall grip, move, release; trigger-select a lit lamp
rows.expected: Same outcomes as RT-04, RT-07, RT-10
rows.actual: squeeze grabbed the grip (phase held, holder right); released inside the snap window: committed detent 1, edge foyer.north|stair.foot open; trigger on the lit stair-head lamp hopped to v-stair-head

rows.title: Save and reload
rows.preconditions: Immersive; chapter at cp-landing (the game writes the save)
rows.inputs: Reload the page; xr enter; fingertip on continue
rows.expected: Seam detents, edges and vantage match the checkpoint
rows.actual: reloaded: Title with continue and no notice; continue restored cp-landing at v-landing-east; 8 open edges and seam detents identical to before; rig/station alignment 0 m

rows.title: Corrupt save
rows.preconditions: Page with controlled local storage (no XR needed)
rows.inputs: Write (1) truncated JSON in the current slot, (2) a record whose edge list does not match its seams, (3) an unknown checkpoint; reload after each
rows.expected: Other slot, then canonical snapshot, then new game; notice shown; no exception
rows.actual: truncated JSON in the current slot, valid record in the other -> continue at cp-landing, notice "Earlier progress could not be restored as saved.", no console error; edge list that does not match the seams -> continue at cp-east, notice "Earlier progress could not be restored as saved.", no console error; unknown checkpoint and nothing usable in the other slot -> new game, notice "Earlier progress could not be restored as saved.", no console error

rows.title: Audio state
rows.preconditions: Immersive; cp-corridor; the encounter driven with game commands (the hands are not under test here)
rows.inputs: Let the Surveyor wake and count; swing the bridge while it is on it (brace, Blocked); let it measure the office; swing back (no route); then hide and show the session
rows.expected: The matching audio request within 0.5 s of each Surveyor state change; audio resumes after pause
rows.actual: wakes (Listening) -> tape 0.00 s; wakes (Listening) -> pencil 0.00 s; count -> knock 0.30 s; bracing -> strain 0.00 s; Blocked -> plumb 0.00 s; measuring -> pencil 0.00 s; measuring -> tape 0.00 s; no route -> tape-long 0.00 s; after hide/show the room-tone loop was re-requested (loop 0.35; SDK source playing=true); Note: this checks the game's audio requests and the SDK source state, not what is heard

rows.title: The letter
rows.preconditions: Immersive; (a) at v-foyer-door, (b) cp-docked at v-zero, (c) at v-foyer-door
rows.inputs: (a) take the letter and release it in mid-air. (b) take it to pigeonhole 0 and release. (c) carry it to the pigeonhole position while not in Room Zero and release
rows.expected: (a) returns to the strap. (b) delivered, ending starts. (c) not delivered
rows.actual: (a) mid-air release: letter strap, back at the strap (-0.3, 0.82, -0.3); (c) at the slot position outside Room Zero: not delivered, no ending; (b) in Room Zero: delivered, ending started (3 step events so far). Slot is 0.53 m from the seated reference point (seated reach limit is 0.55 m)

rows.title: Lamps and scene join
rows.preconditions: Dev page; no XR needed
rows.inputs: For 20 spread seam configurations and every vantage compare lit lamps with the domain reachable set; check every content ID has its scene object; check every station grip against the seated reach envelope
rows.expected: Identical sets; join check passes; all grips in the envelope
rows.actual: 20 configurations x 11 vantages = 220 comparisons: lit lamps identical to the domain's reachable set; every module, socket, beacon, station, seal and setting seal present (7 stations); every grip end inside the seated reach envelope

rows.title: Unsupported platform, refused session and production build
rows.preconditions: (a) production build served from a sub-path in a separate headless Chromium with no emulator; (b) the emulator page with the session request made to fail
rows.inputs: (a) open /room-zero/ ; (b) click Enter VR with requestSession rejecting, then with it restored
rows.expected: (a) page explains that a headset browser is needed; no emulator code; no request to another origin. (b) message and a working retry
rows.actual: (a) production build from /room-zero/: "This needs a VR headset browser. Open this address in the Meta Quest Browser."; Enter VR disabled; no emulator globals, dev hook or emulator code in the bundle (SDK-internal globals present: __IWSDK_LUCIDE_ICONS_TRIMMED__); 35 requests, none to another origin, 0 failed; (b) session request refused: "The headset did not start VR. Try again.", Enter VR re-enabled; after restoring it the retry started a session

rows.title: Error boundary and asset failure
rows.preconditions: Immersive; chapter running. Then fault injection through the browser context
rows.inputs: (a) make a tick throw; touch the card's retry. (b) block one background asset (audio/knock.wav), reload, play. (c) block the game script (the critical asset), reload; unblock; Try again
rows.expected: (a) ticking stops; error card; restart works. (b) play continues. (c) the page reports it and retry works
rows.actual: (a) a tick threw: error card shown, ticks stopped (150); fingertip on retry restarted the chapter at its opening (Exploration), not the title; (b) audio/knock.wav blocked: the game booted and the chapter started (Exploration), no error card; (c) production build with the game bundle failing to load (404): page said "The house could not be prepared: a file did not load. Check your connection and try again." with Try again visible; with the bundle served again, Try again recovered ("This needs a VR headset browser. Open this address in the Meta Quest Browser.")
rows.note: Restart after an error returns to the chapter opening, not to the title as the matrix text says
